author_protocols_separately_identified.title: MATQ-seq protocol
author_protocols_separately_identified.association_basis: Original MATQ-seq article DOI 10.1038/nmeth.4145 explicitly cites this author protocol as reference 21. The protocol's own title, authors and DOI were inspected. This is a separate publication, not a recovered copy of the journal article.
author_protocols_separately_identified.scope_note: Author protocol for the original eukaryotic MATQ-seq. Do not substitute later bacterial MATQ-seq implementations or silently transfer their parameters. The original journal article remains a separate acquisition obligation.

Own title, authors, DOI and procedure section were inspected. This is a separate publication, not a recovered copy of the journal article.
author_protocols_separately_identified.scope_note: CRISPR-UMI pooled-screen lineage tracing author protocol. Its separately linked Main Document 1 and primer table must be obtained when needed; this PDF alone does not establish that every attachment is available.
